summary: CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI Petition No. 1029/TL/2025 Coram: Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member Date of Order: 19.10.2026 In the matter of Application under Section-14 & 15 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for Grant of Transmission License and other related matters) Regulations, 2024 for Grant of separate Transmission License for Transmission system for providing connectivity to RE applicant(s) at Navinal (Mundra)(GIS) under Regulated Tariff Mechanism (RTM) route. And In the Matter Of: Navinal Transmission Limited, C 105, Anand Niketan, New Delhi 110021 .... Petitioner Vs 1. The Petitioner is an Inter-State Transmission Licensee, implementing the transmission project “Network Expansion Scheme in Navinal (Mundra) area of Gujarat for drawal of power in the area” on a Build, Own, Operate and Transfer (hereinafter referred to as “BOOT”) basis awarded through the Tariff Based Competitive Bidding route (hereinafter referred to as “TBCB Project”). The Commission, vide order dated 19.11.2025 in Petition No. 426/TL/2024, granted a transmission licence to the Petitioner for the TBCB Project consisting of the following: S. Considering the material on record, and subject to our observations and directions under the Order for CTUIL to file the information, we direct that a public notice in two daily digital newspapers and on the Commission’s website under clause (a) of sub-section (5) of Section 15 of the Act be published to invite suggestions or objections to the grant of a transmission licence aforesaid. The objections or suggestions, if any, be filed by any person before the Commission on or before 05.11.2026. 34. It is noted that the NCT, vide approval dated 14.07.2025, requested the CTUIL to take necessary action for entering into a Concession Agreement with the respective agency for implementation of the instant scheme. Accordingly, CTUIL is directed to provide a copy of the Concession Agreement within a month. 35. The Petition shall be listed for hearing on 10.11.2026.
